title: BUGFIX — cmd-delivery.ts cmdDeliver + cmdPickup can send same video twice in batch
rationale: cmdDeliver() line 45 and cmdPickup() line 393 build unposted list from publish-ledger.jsonl without deduplicating by video_id. After sorting and diversification, the same video_id can appear in batch — operator receives duplicate video in a single /deliver call. Fix with seenVids Set. Single-video pickers (cmdCaption, cmdDeliverNext) are functionally OK since they take [0].

tasks.description: Add seenVids Set to cmdDeliver() ~line 45 and cmdPickup() ~line 393 in scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-delivery.ts
